metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the `ical` CLI in Node.js (standard library only) under `output/`.

- Entry point: `output/main.js` (runnable as `node output/main.js ...`)
- Executable shim: `output/ical` (runnable as `output/ical ...`)
- Subcommands:
  - `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
  - `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO> --to <ISO> --output <out.json>`

Key files:
- `output/src/ics_parser.js`: RFC 5545 content-line parsing + unfolding, parameter parsing (incl. RFC 6868 escapes), warnings/errors
- `output/src/parse.js`: maps VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY(+AVAILABLE)/VALARM into the required JSON schemas
- `output/src/expand.js`: expands VEVENT series in a window, applies `RRULE`/`RDATE`/`EXDATE`/`EXRULE`, and resolves `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides (incl. `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`)
- `output/src/timezone.js`: VTIMEZONE resolver (local→UTC), including gap/fold warnings (`nonexistent_local_time`, `timezone_fold_ambiguous`)
- `output/src/itip.js`: iTIP METHOD constraint warnings (`itip_missing_property`)

Run examples:
- `node output/main.js parse --input calendar.ics --output parsed.json`
- `node output/main.js expand --input calendar.ics --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-02-01 --output occurrences.json`
